references.text: Instructions on offering the fat, kidneys, and large lobe of the liver as part of the peace offering to the Lord.
Description of how the fat, kidneys, and liver lobe are to be removed from the sin offering and burned on the altar.
The fat is to be removed and burned on the altar as a pleasing aroma to the Lord, just as with the peace offering.
The fat, kidneys, and liver lobe are mentioned as parts to be offered from the guilt offering.
Moses took the fat that covered the entrails, the large lobe of the liver, and both kidneys with their fat and burned it on the altar.
The same practice of burning the fat, liver lobe, and kidneys on the altar during the consecration of priests.
The fat, the fatty tail, all the fat on the entrails, the liver lobe, and both kidneys were taken from the ram.
